    }

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4607370928",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider the wrapper approach where the budget lifetime is explicitly scoped to the wrapper or ParamsStream rather than using mutable state on streams.",
      "quote": "the lifetime of the budget there is just the wrapper, which seems fairly explicit to me?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author adopted wrapper approach with non-overridable parameter feature",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4621169370"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4621169370",
      "status_by_quote": "I've switched to your approach, but added a feature for parameters to declare they cannot be overridden"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5977344049",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "Explain whether the complexity and minimal CPU cost of the last few commits is worth it given other memory-eating places in Bitcoin Core.",
      "quote": "Are they really worth the complexity (and minimal cpu cost) when there are other places in Bitcoin Core that can eat memory (including in p2p). Are we going to address all of them?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author agreed the performance gains did not justify the complexity and dropped all but the first two commits",
      "author_replies": ["c:7021692240", "r:6006636619"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:6006636619",
      "status_by_quote": "I have dropped all but the first two commits; I think it's fair that the performance gains don't justify the complexity being added here."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4629170452",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Oversized blocks failing deserialization are not disconnected, so the block request stays in mapBlocksInFlight until the 10-minute download timeout expires, potentially stalling block download.",
      "quote": "Since the peer isn't disconnected, the hash stays in mapBlocksInFlight until the 10-minute download timeout expires.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author noted it's similar to peers not responding to getdata, and will investigate blanket disconnects separately",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4629650852"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4629650852",
      "status_by_quote": "That's a fair concern. It's no different from how we treat a peer that never responds to a `getdata` requests at all"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:7038398695",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Whether leaving solicited blocks that fail early deserialization in mapBlocksInFlight until the download timeout expires was the intended behavior.",
      "quote": "Was leaving it to the timeout the intended behavior here?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "Husteem dropped the question after acknowledging it was LLM-assisted and rehashed earlier discussions",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:7038945164",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd also pay closer attention to earlier discussions before asking my questions."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {

  ],
  "notes": "Author benchmarked the commits and dropped all but the first two commits, resolving maflcko's concern about added complexity.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review of the simplified PR after dropping the weight-accounting commits",
      "id": "r:6006636619"
    }
  ]
}
